//: Everything that runs in Node rather than the browser: the Vite config, the
model fetcher, and the VMC bridge. Kept separate from tsconfig.json so DOM
code cannot reach for Node globals and vice versa.
The bridge and scripts are plain .mjs, so checkJs is what gives them any
checking at all — before this they were covered by nothing.
Deliberately not strict: demanding JSDoc annotations on a hand-rolled OSC
decoder would block builds on inference noise rather than defects. checkJs
without noImplicitAny still catches what matters here — unresolved modules,
wrong arity, misspelled properties, misused Node APIs.
